Privacy notice for this version of the EasyOra website.

Last updated: 15 October 2026

Project brief builder

The brief builder processes your entries in your browser to create text you can copy. It does not submit a form, send an email, or save your entries to a database or browser storage. The copy button uses your browser’s clipboard permission to copy the generated text. Your clipboard may retain it until you replace it.

Cookies and analytics

This website does not add analytics scripts, advertising trackers, or application cookies. Fonts and visual assets are served with the site. The hosting platform may process technical request information and use access-control mechanisms to deliver this private preview.

Private preview access

The preview is hosted through Sites with owner-only access. Platform authentication and hosting practices are governed by the platform’s own policies.

Information you choose to share

Copying a brief does not send it to EasyOra. If you share it using another service, that service’s handling of your information applies. Avoid including confidential credentials or sensitive personal information.

Contact details

EasyOra’s public contact destinations have not yet been supplied for this preview. This notice will need to be updated if contact submission, analytics, or other data processing is added.
